$comment: Size budgets, checked by scripts/check-budgets.ts after next build (#152). They start at what the app shipped when they were set. Lower one whenever a change makes room; raise one only in a pull request that says what the bytes buy (stage 2's palette and theme rule: 0.4 KB of JavaScript, 0.5 KB of CSS). First-load JavaScript counts every layout above the page, which Next's build table leaves out, so it reads about 23 KB above that table. /book's target is 100 KB (docs/visual-language.md); stage 5a's rebuild is where it gets there.
